title: Biodiversity Fabric Simulator Schema
description: Defines species archetypes, habitat succession, and telemetry knobs for the biodiversity simulator.

id.description: Unique identifier for the species archetype.

metabolism.description: Metabolic parameters controlling internal state drift and resource usage.

energy_decay.description: Baseline energy decay applied each step.

hazard_tolerance.description: Normalized tolerance for hazard exposure before integrity loss.

resource_preference.description: Primary resource channel this species prefers (e.g., 'food', 'coolant').

maintenance.description: Station usage preferences for the maintenance manager.

preferred_tasks.description: Maintenance task IDs prioritized by the species.

population.description: Population-level safety requirements for the species.

min_count.description: Minimum viable population for the species.

max_count.description: Carrying capacity for the species within the simulator.

energy_floor.description: Minimum average energy that the species must maintain.

succession.description: Ecological succession configuration controlling phased habitat changes.

interval.description: Number of timesteps between succession phase evaluations.

food_density.description: Probability of spawning food in each cell for the phase.

hazard_rate.description: Probability of hazard presence in each cell for the phase.

adversary_scale.description: Scaling factor for adversary or disturbance intensity.

telemetry.description: Telemetry aggregation knobs for biodiversity metrics.

stability_window.description: Rolling window size for computing trophic stability.
